subject: FAQ : MSstats external tool in Skyline - installation error

messages.author: df9ba0266a9a081f
messages.subject: FAQ : MSstats external tool in Skyline - installation error
parts:
One possible error message for installation of MSstats external tool in Skyline is reported. (Thanks, E Yang)

=======================================

** Reading the data for MSstats.....

Error in unique(raw$StandardType) :

  error in evaluating the argument 'x' in selecting a method for function 'unique': Error in raw$StandardType : $ operator is invalid for atomic vectors

Can't finish analysis. Please check "msstats.log".


The reason for this error message is that installation of newest version of MSstats external tool (MSstats.2.1.5) is not complete. It is reported by Window 7 computer.

Here is my suggestions (possible solutions) :

a) uninstall R through control panel
 

b) delete R folder under “C:/Users/XXX(your name)/Documents/“ or “C:/Program Files/“

c) if you have antivirus program, please pause antivirus program while installing the packages because antivirus program interrupt to install required R packages)

d) Try to install MSstats through external tool stores in Skyline again.

To check whether recent MSstats external tool is properly installed,
a) open R
b) run 'library(MSstats)'
c) run 'sessionInfo()'
Then result should have 'MSstats_2.1.5' in the list.

If there is anybody who has the same error, could you let us know how this solution goes? It will be helpful for next users and also us to fix the problem.


Meena

messages.author: 709cf6648d44d792
messages.subject: Re: FAQ : MSstats external tool in Skyline - installation error
parts: Hello. I have solved this problem by correcting R script "MSStatsQC.r". The thing is that when Skyline generates file with raw data for MSStats it uses ";" as separator. In the script standart function read.csv() is used to read this file. But standart separator for this function is ",". So, we need to define separator. The row "raw<-read.csv(arguments[1])" should be replaced by "raw<-read.csv(arguments[1], sep=';')".

messages.author: 701dadf5d5bd3f3b
messages.subject: Re: FAQ : MSstats external tool in Skyline - installation error

messages.author: 709cf6648d44d792
messages.subject: Re: FAQ : MSstats external tool in Skyline - installation error
parts: Better solution is to change locale to "English (US)" or to change the parameter "list separator" in local settings to ",".
